scope: API local: consentimiento, transcripción persistente, reportes e integración de archivos/IA

integration.services: Firebase Auth emulator + PostgreSQL + API reales
integration.speechScope: El lote sintético de silencio verificó autorización/formato/idempotencia/estado; las palabras reales se verifican por separado en el navegador con Whisper.

checks: same clientId/hash idempotence; repeated phrases retained
failed batch and capture gap visible without stored audio
closing grace/clamp and pending artifacts wait
report/document IDOR and signed URL provenance
private answers and original question serialization
complete transcript/chat/file exports; personal notes excluded
DOCX raw text and encrypted/oversize/traversal ZIP rejection
OCR truncation marks partial; failure still stores attachment
RAG questions up to 6KB with authorized source citations
Dynamic RAG budget fits model context; small questions generate directly
Long report summaries condense with explicit word/reference limits
Output/context limits are terminal scope errors instead of identical disconnect retries
limitations: ASR accuracy is not guaranteed. Uncaptured audio cannot be reconstructed.
ngrok/PC availability and free quotas can leave visible missing intervals.
PDF extraction limited to first100 pages, marked partial; original available whole.
OCR extracts text rather than interpreting visual content; truncated OCR is partial.
API integration does not itself certify real ASR words; browser evidence provides that check.

queueRegression.cause: Gateway OUTPUT_LIMIT on an unnecessary intermediate384token summary; repeated5times
queueRegression.fix: Direct generation when context fits; dynamic retrieval window and bounded summaries; permanent scope error classification

realModelDiagnostic.scope: Direct real generation; browser/production evidence separately verifies durable queue completion
